resources.name: TBS PFE API
resources.description: Select the environment 'TBS PFE Local'. Tokens are saved by after-response scripts.

resources.name: 1. Demo script
resources.description: Run in order on a FRESH server started with a 30-second access token. This is the video script.

resources.name: D01 Public - GET all reports (privacy proof)
resources.description: Public route, no token. Test checks that 'student_id' appears NOWHERE in the response.

resources.name: D02 Public - filter keyword + major
resources.description: Keyword searches title + key features, case-insensitive.

resources.name: D03 Public - GET one report
resources.description: One report through the public_report() serializer: no student_id.

resources.name: D04 GET /students without token -> 401
resources.description: Student data (with CIN-like ids) is protected.

resources.name: D05 Login -> save tokens
resources.description: Saves access_token and refresh_token into the environment automatically.

resources.name: D06 GET /students with token -> 200
D07 Wait for expiry, retry -> 401 expired
resources.description: WAIT ~30 seconds after D05/D06 before sending this one. Requires the server to run with ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_SECONDS=30.

resources.name: D08 Refresh -> new pair (rotation)
resources.description: Sends the REFRESH token as Bearer. Old refresh token is kept in old_refresh_token for D12, then both tokens are replaced.

resources.name: D09 Retry GET /students -> 200
D10 POST report breaking relationship rule -> 409
resources.description: Yasmine is single major (double_major = 0) and already has 1 report.

resources.name: D11 POST report with invalid data -> 422
resources.description: Every problem is listed at once in the message, separated by |.

resources.name: D12 Reuse OLD refresh token -> 401 revoked
resources.description: Rotation: the refresh token used in D08 was revoked and cannot be reused.

resources.name: D13 Logout -> revoke both tokens
D14 Use token after logout -> 401 revoked
2. CRUD tour
resources.description: POST, GET All, GET By Id, PUT and DELETE for both lists. Video part 2: restart the server with the normal 5-minute token first.

resources.description: Full update. student_id comes from the URL and cannot change.

resources.description: Allowed because Rania has no reports.

C07 Reports - GET All (public)
